### workspace set-command --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace set-command [project] <command> --pane <N> [--name WS]

Set the shell command for a specific pane in a project's tmuxinator config.

Pane index N is 1-based. If N exceeds the number of existing panes,
you will be asked whether to append a new pane.

Options:
        --name WS                    The project, as an option; then give only <command>
                    With no project, give the command as one quoted argument: two
                    arguments always mean PROJECT COMMAND. The project then defaults to
                    the current directory's.
        --pane N                     Pane index (1-based)

Examples:
  workspace set-command 'vim .' --pane 2    # the current directory's project
  workspace set-command --name myproject 'vim .' --pane 2    # a named project
  workspace set-command myproject 'vim .' --pane 2    # replace the second pane's command
  workspace set-command scooter 'ascii-banner "scooter" --rainbow' --pane 1    # replace the banner pane
  workspace set-command myproject 'htop' --pane 4    # add a fourth pane (prompts if only 3 exist)
--- stderr
--- end
